hooks.command: cli="$HOME/.config/process-rules/bin/process-rules"; [ -x "$cli" ] || cli=process-rules; if said=$("$cli" session-start 2>&1); then printf '%s\n' "$said"; else printf '%s\n' "process-rules: STOP. process-rules session-start did not run here ($said), so this session cannot be given the agent identity and GitHub is locked out of it. Do not push, fetch, or run gh in this session; tell the owner."; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -nE 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(([^"\\]|\\.)*)".*/\1/p'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(gh|git)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' || exit 0; cli="$HOME/.config/process-rules/bin/process-rules"; [ -x "$cli" ] || cli=process-rules; printf '%s' "$input" | "$cli" guard && exit 0; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "process-rules: refused, because the process-rules CLI did not run here to check this command. Do not work around it; tell the owner." >&2; exit 2

env.GIT_SSH_COMMAND: echo 'process-rules: SSH is off in agent sessions; GitHub goes over HTTPS' >&2; false
